notes.title: Easter Update!
notes.content:
🐤 The Slime Sprint Easter update has just been released! This includes 10 new levels and 2 new skins to play with. That also means there are 10 more diamond medals to grind for! The regular gems that are collected have been switch out with Easter eggs, new homing enemies have been added and a new box map style has been included. Be sure to update and play to check out all the new features!🐇
🐣
Slime Sprint is on sale from 10:00 PT on Saturday 3rd April for 7 days so if you enjoy the game be sure to give it a share over this period!🐥

notes.title: Steam Achievements Added!
notes.content:
[b]PATCH 1.01 UPDATE[/b]

Hey gamers, Rob from Topside Studio here posting to update you on the latest news for Slime Sprint. Steam achievements have officially been added totalling 20 across a range of features. These include achievements for gold earn, levels completed and jumps jumped so be sure to try and unlock as many as possible. Shop skin and trail prices have also been altered and multiple bugs fixed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509478/2e11f8d3e07a7fb82ba27b4ba6e71bfb29f7c51a.png[/img]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

Several Bug have already been patched since launch but a few still remain. I would like to take this opportunity to thank anyone who reported a bug. Updates over the next week should fix any outstanding bugs but as always be sure to report any you see.

[b]Future Update[/b]

A large Valentines update will be coming on [b]Wednesday the 10th February[/b] containing an additional 10 map update. Be sure to check out the love themed skins that will also be added along with the update! After this update, plans are in place for more events throughout the year for Easter, Summer Special, Halloween and Christmas so be sure to follow for future updates.

Next update will be around the Valentines update!
